title: Introduce release-preview-streamer and profile rollforward allocator
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a release-preview-streamer service and a profile rollforward allocator to automate draft release notes for model onboarding and staged rollouts. Motivation: manual changelog drafting and ad-hoc rollforwards cause delays and inconsistent notes for model profile updates. This PR introduces a preview endpoint (+CLI) that synthesizes a candidate release note from model_profile deltas, telemetry-weighted sample highlights, and provenance anchors; a watermark-backed change tracker that emits incremental release fragments; and a rollforward allocator that computes safe staged rollout cohorts and suggested rollback checkpoints. The implementation includes a small schema migration (model_profile_events table + watermark index), a new service (preview-streamer) with a streaming SSE/HTTP endpoint, a CLI command (mr release-preview) for maintainers, server-side heuristics for 'noise' filtering (min-sample-count, stable-baseline threshold), and integration hooks for the changelog composer used by the docs pipeline. Checklist: [x] schema migration and migration tests, [x] unit tests for delta scoring, [x] e2e test that verifies preview -> publish flow, [x] Linear links in commit messages, [x] docs draft in /docs/release-previews.md, [ ] follow-up telemetry dashboard for preview quality (separate PR). Backwards compatibility: new tables and endpoints are additive; existing onboarding flows are unchanged by default. Runtime note: the rollforward allocator uses a conservative default cohort size and can be tuned via config flags per-organization. See release_notes and review_conversation for important decisions and follow-ups.
commits: 3 commits: 1) add preview-streamer service, CLI scaffold, and basic handler; 2) migration: model_profile_events + watermark index; 3) rollforward allocator, heuristics, tests, docs and CI fixes.
review_conversation: Liam: 'Why add a new table instead of embedding events into profiles?' Author: 'We need append-only events to maintain provenance and cheap incremental scans; profiles remain compact.' Aisha: 'Suggest stronger default noise thresholds; we saw false positives in perf canary.' Author: 'Raised default stable-baseline threshold from 0.6 to 0.7, added flag to override per-org.' Diego: 'We need clear ownership for published drafts — who can promote preview to final?' Author: 'Added CLI guard and required 'release-captain' role (RBAC) for publish; will follow up with policy docs.' CI: intermittent lint flake fixed by formatting rule in presubmit; all tests passing on rerun.
release_notes:
- Add release-preview-streamer service and mr release-preview CLI to auto-generate draft release notes for model onboarding and profile updates.
- Introduce model_profile_events table and watermark-based incremental change emitter to power concise changelog fragments.
- Add rollforward allocator to compute conservative staged rollout cohorts and suggested rollback checkpoints.
- Add docs: docs/release-previews.md and CLI usage examples.
Notes: default rollout policies are conservative; configure per-organization via model-registry config.
